title: BUSY Bar project
description: Create a BUSY Bar app or library in TypeScript or Python, wired into Nx, the Yarn or uv workspace, linting, type checking, and tests.

name.description: Project name in kebab-case, such as `weather`. It names the directory, the Nx project, and the package.

type.description: `app` for a runnable BUSY Bar app under apps/, `lib` for shared code under libs/.

skipInstall.description: Skip `yarn install` or `uv lock` after generating. The new project is formatted either way.
